name: engine_check

estimate.basis: benzene measured first, as registered: 810 s (optimisation 113 s, the two Hessians 697 s; 2 Nov 18:20-18:33); the other seven scaled by (atoms/12)^3 to 1.0-2.3 h each, 11.5 h together, plus room for the ring torsions' longer optimisations (biphenyl, benzophenone); the water smoke took 23 s
